claims.shared_lemma: theorem PrimeSpectrum.ordConnected_zeroLocus {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (s : Set R) : (zeroLocus s).OrdConnected := IsUpperSet.ordConnected fun _ _ hpq hp => by rw [mem_zeroLocus] at hp ⊢; exact hp.trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hpq)
